name: Holiday Inn & Suites Manila Galleria
short_description: A 285-room Holiday Inn in Ortigas Center, Pasig, with 36 suites and Ortigas' only two-level penthouse, directly linked to Robinsons Galleria Mall.
ai_summary: Holiday Inn & Suites Manila Galleria occupies 1 Asian Development Bank Avenue in Ortigas Center, Pasig City, on a site that opened in 1993 and previously operated as the Manila Galleria Suites before rebranding under IHG. Robinsons Land Corp invested roughly PHP 1 billion renovating the property, with all 285 rooms -- including 36 suites -- refreshed and unveiled in September 2024 alongside a new Summit Lounge with city skyline views and the only two-level penthouse suite in Ortigas. The hotel is directly connected to Robinsons Galleria Mall and shares pool, gym, and spa facilities with its sister property Crowne Plaza Manila Galleria next door. TripAdvisor rates it 4.0/5, ranked around #12 of 37 hotels in Pasig, with reviewers consistently praising the mall-adjacent convenience, spacious renovated rooms, and warm staff service. Some reviews flag residual renovation smells and noise as the refresh continued in phases, and the location, roughly 15 km (about 35 minutes by car) from Ninoy Aquino International Airport, is better suited to Ortigas business travel and family staycations than airport layovers.

faqs.question: Has Holiday Inn & Suites Manila Galleria been renovated recently?
faqs.answer: Yes -- Robinsons Land Corp invested roughly PHP 1 billion renovating all 285 rooms and suites, with the refreshed property, including a new Summit Lounge and a two-level penthouse suite, formally unveiled in September 2024 after the property previously operated as Manila Galleria Suites.

faqs.question: Is Holiday Inn & Suites Manila Galleria connected to a shopping mall?
faqs.answer: Yes -- the hotel has direct access to Robinsons Galleria Mall in Ortigas Center, and SM Megamall and Podium Mall are also within short walking distance, making it a popular staycation choice for shopping and dining convenience.

faqs.question: How far is the hotel from Ninoy Aquino International Airport?
faqs.answer: It sits roughly 15 kilometers from NAIA, typically about a 35-minute drive depending on Manila traffic, so travelers prioritizing a short airport transfer may prefer a property closer to Pasay's Newport City rather than this Ortigas Center location.
